description: The template covers the template picker shows, called by the picker itself. Use showTemplates instead. At most 10 templates a call.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

reportId.description: The report the user picks a template for, by its `id` from `listReports`: the picker warns about the slides each template has no layout for. Its `type` must be `SlideDeck`, and you need edit access to it. Leave it out when the user picks one for a new report.

name: getTemplatePickerCovers
title: Get template picker covers
